name: Preset store
threading: Pure functions; thread-safe. Not real-time safe (allocates).
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/preset_store -B build/preset_store && cmake --build build/preset_store && ctest --test-dir build/preset_store
summary: Versioned preset records for generation settings, Fractal Rhythm motif and Evolve cadence: validation, bounded binary (de)serialization with a checksum, six factory presets, and safe file-name derivation. Pure data: files and folders are handled by the plugin shell.
limits: Name 1..48 characters; motif 2..8 cells of x, a, .
Files are small (under 512 bytes); deserialize rejects truncation, trailing bytes, bad magic or checksum, unknown versions
adapters: Your app maps a Preset onto its own parameters and UI fields; this module never touches a host or filesystem.
adapter_notes: Presets never contain a seed or a pattern; applying one changes settings only.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose presets only.
